notes: Treating animals at a check-in desk with medicine on hand is a defined, repeatable job loop, which the Roleplay genre's own boundary note sends to Simulation's Role Sim rather than to open-ended roleplay, so no second genre is named. Role Sim's world-open shape is replaced by space-bounded, taken from outside Simulation's typical list, because the prompt asks for walls on the edge and the whole game happens on that one walled clinic site rather than in a roamable world; space-bounded itself routes nothing. P3 is real here since the clinic is entered rather than admired from the road, and the stated second floor stacks surfaces over each other, which is what adds P2 on top of it. Without a user to ask I read a pad as the player spawn the answer confirms, three of them at five players each in the lobby, took the ten medicine items as pickup collectibles, and left the road as ordinary walkable circulation rather than a vehicle route, since no ambulance or car was mentioned; the three spawn pads and the coffee corner have no option to carry them and are recorded here.
